parties:
Bangladesh Shipping Corporation and another ----- Petitioners
Vs.
Raquibuddin Ahmed ----- Opposite-Party
full_judgment: Mr. Faiz has taken another point that this suit is barred by limitation in view of the fact that this suit was not filed within one year from the date of termination of service as required under Article 14 of the Limitation Act. Article 14 of the Limitation Act provides that if any order is passed by an officer of the Government, then it should be challenged within one year from the date of order. Article 120 is a residuary article which speaks that if the specific period is not provided in the Limitation Act, then within six years from the date of impugned action, the action may be challenged in Court. Here in this case we find that no order of any Government officer has been challenged in the suit. It appears that direction was given by the Ministry and in pursuance of that direction the Corporation had passed the order of termination. So, it is an alleged order of the Corporation. In the circumstances, we are of the view that the present case will be guided by Article 120 and not by Article 14 of the Limitation Act.
